    The emulator's settings and their defaults

    emulatorDefaults.Rd

    emulatorControl (a module parameter) overrides any of these by name.

    emulatorDefaults()

    Value

    a named list:

    • designPerParam (20): the space-filling design (maximin Latin hypercube, lhs::maximinLHS()) has this many points per parameter, each evaluated once;

    • designRepPoints (4), designReps (6): that many of the design points are evaluated designReps times more, so the GP sees the noise away from the optimum;

    • globalMaxEvals (1000), maxEvals (1600): the budget of real evaluations of the global phase, and of both phases together;

    • minEvals (600): the global phase does not stop for lack of improvement before this many evaluations;

    • globalWindow (6), relTol (0.002): the global phase stops when the GP's best mean (at an evaluated point) improved by less than relTol times itself over its last globalWindow batches (the prototype: 2 objective units at ~938);

    • batchSize (NULL): evaluations per batch; NULL is the cluster's number of workers, or 48 without one;

    • floorFrac (0.8), globalCapRatio (10), localCapRatio (1.18): the GP models log(min(y, cap) - floorFrac * min(y)), with cap globalCapRatio times the best value seen in the global phase and localCapRatio times the GP's best mean in the local phase, so failures (the objective's fail value, and runaway sets scored in the millions) sit on a plateau instead of dominating the fit;

    • nCandidates (4000), nPerturb (3000), perturbSD (c(0.005, 0.015, 0.04, 0.1)), nTop (20): each batch is chosen from nCandidates Latin-hypercube points (in the trust region in the local phase) and nPerturb Gaussian perturbations, at each perturbSD (unit-cube scale), of the nTop best points by GP mean;

    • exclusion (0.25): batch members are at least this far apart in lengthscale units;

    • lcbSD (2): the exploration picks minimise the GP mean minus this many standard deviations;

    • logSpanMin (20): the search space (emulatorSpace()) puts a parameter on a signed log1p scale when one of its bounds is 0 and the other is at least this far from 0; the others are linear;

    • the local phase, trust-region rounds of trustRoundBatches (2) batches each: the region is the box around the best localTopFrac (0.1) of all distinct evaluated points by GP mean, widened by localWiden (0.5) of its width each side, times the round's scale (emulatorTrustBox()). After each round (emulatorTrustStep()), an improvement of the GP's best mean by more than trustTolSD (1) times the objective's noise SD (emulatorNoiseSD()), and by more than relTol times the best mean (the floor while there are few or no replicates near it), is a success, else a failure; trustSuccessTol (1) successes in a row multiply the scale by trustShrink (0.5), a failure multiplies it by trustExpand (1.25, at most 1), and trustFailureTol (2) failures in a row stop the search. It also stops when the region's widest side is narrower than trustMinWidth (0.01 of the unit cube; not relative to the GP's lengthscales, which reach their upper bound when the local cap flattens the response), or at maxEvals;

    • popPoolFrac (0.2), popMinDist (1): the starting population is picked from the best popPoolFrac of the distinct evaluated points (by their mean value; at least NP of them), best first, skipping a point closer than popMinDist GP lengthscales to one already picked, the distance halved until NP are picked (emulatorSpreadPopulation()), so separate good regions are all in it;

    • thetaBounds (c(0.01, 5)), gpMaxit (200), gpThreads (6): the GP's lengthscale bounds (unit cube), optimiser iterations (hetGP::mleHetGP()) and BLAS threads (the rest of the search runs on one).
